parts.text: Get the weather for Paris and Berlin and, at the same time, give me your final answer. Do everything in one step: call the weather tool for both cities and also give the final structured answer in the same response.
You are a weather assistant. Always give your final answer in the same response as your tool calls, never in a separate turn.

functionDeclarations.description: Get the current weather for a city.
functionDeclarations.name: get_weather

functionDeclarations.description: Respond to the user's request by invoking this tool. The arguments object IS the answer — there is no further reasoning step. Do not emit any other output.
functionDeclarations.name: respond_with_json
